# book_code (Resource)

The code records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references

### Optional

- `action_id` (String) Action fired when the code is resolved.
- `asset_id` (String) The key of the asset record.
- `bookable_id` (String) The key of the bookable record.
- `bookable_type_id` (String) The key of the bookable_type record.
- `booking_id` (String) The key of the booking record.
- `capability_id` (String) The key of the capability record.
- `count` (Number) Maximum number of resolutions. 0 means unlimited and is the default.
- `data` (Dynamic)
- `description` (String)
- `ends_at` (String) Latest moment the code can be resolved.
- `expires_at` (String) Moment the code is treated as expired regardless of count.
- `input` (Dynamic) Payload passed to the action on resolution.
- `name` (String) Display name of the code, defaults to a generated label.
- `object_id` (String) Object the code resolves to.
- `object_type` (String) Type of the object the code resolves to. With capability the code represents that capability: scanning or redeeming it raises the events of the capability on code_scanned and code_redeemed and runs the actions bound to the capability on them.
- `owner_id` (String) Organisation that owns the code. Required unless object_id and object_type are set.
- `redeemed_at` (String)
- `redeemed_count` (Number)
- `starts_at` (String) Earliest moment the code can be resolved.
- `styling` (Dynamic) Visual styling applied when rendering the code.
- `value` (String) The token the code encodes.
